items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: I believe the bass player on that record was Peter Washington I think.

ctx.x: Okay so I got a call from — who did I get it from — well I got a call from he was the bass player I think on that record, or something like that. And he said, “Yeah I’ve got this record date coming up and it’s for Jimmy Ponder, you want to do it?” I said, “Yeah, sure

I’d love to do it. I know Jimmy Ponder’s music.” And so then what I did, I started checking out Jimmy’s music and trying to see what I could do with it. I remember we did, on that record date, “The Creator Has a Master Plan.” And you know that’s really not a typical tune you would do. But you know I knew about it enough where I could do something with it. And that was great. I believe the bass player on that record was Peter Washington I think. And oh, and the drummer was the guy who played on “Song for my…
Oh I should know this. I’m not passing the audition at the moment.
